input: Learn to read a mutual fund prospectus properly

gold.taskTitle: Learn to Read a Mutual Fund Prospectus Properly
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to develop the skill of reading and understanding a mutual fund prospectus with confidence and accuracy.

questions.title: What is your current investing knowledge level?
questions.description: Understanding whether the user is a complete beginner, has some investing experience, or is financially literate will shape how foundational the plan needs to be.

questions.title: Do you have a specific prospectus you are looking at?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user has a real prospectus in hand versus learning the skill abstractly helps tailor the plan to something concrete and immediately applicable.

questions.title: What is driving your need to read a prospectus now?
questions.description: Understanding the motivation, such as evaluating a retirement fund, choosing between options, or general financial literacy, helps prioritize which sections matter most.

questions.title: Which sections feel most confusing or intimidating to you?
questions.description: Identifying pain points like expense ratios, risk factors, fund objectives, or performance data helps focus effort where it is most needed.

questions.title: Are you investing through a workplace plan like a 401k?
questions.description: Workplace retirement plans often use simplified summary prospectuses with different layouts, so the context of where the fund is held affects the learning approach.

questions.title: How much time can you dedicate to this each week?
questions.description: Knowing the user's available time helps set a realistic pace, whether they want to master this in a weekend or spread it over several weeks.

questions.title: Do you prefer learning by reading, watching, or hands-on practice?
questions.description: The user's preferred learning style will determine whether the plan leans toward articles and books, video walkthroughs, or annotating a real prospectus directly.
